origins.section: Only the Log Says Whether a Hint Was Used
Filters Choose Which Values Come Back
An LP Starts From a Basis, Not a Hint

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-same-objective: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-same-objective: 'A hint never changes the answer of a solve that runs to optimality'; 'the reliable way to know is to read the solver's log'.
recorded.prompt:q-filtered-values: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-filtered-values: 'Read a binary as chosen when its value is above 0.5, never when it is "not zero".'
recorded.prompt:q-lp-start: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-start: 'initial_basis=... hands a basis saved from one result to a new, separate solve'. 'A basis can be stored with the result and used by any later process.'

recorded.prompt:q-same-objective: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.outcome:q-same-objective: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'b'
recorded.because:q-same-objective: c's 'always' rules out only c, and the rest are not separated

recorded.prompt:q-same-objective:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-same-objective:a: The objective is the same with any hint; HiGHS's log showed the complete hint accepted while the NPV was unchanged.
recorded.prompt:q-same-objective:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-same-objective:c: The 'wrong' hint was complete (80 of 80), yet HiGHS rejected it: 'cannot yield feasible solution'.
recorded.prompt:q-same-objective:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-same-objective:d: 'A hint never changes the answer of a solve that runs to optimality'.
recorded.prompt:q-filtered-values:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-filtered-values:a: HiGHS returned -2.2e-15 under skip_zero_values: 'a filter shortens the result; it does not clean it.'
recorded.prompt:q-filtered-values:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.prompt:q-filtered-values:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-filtered-values:d: '"skip zero values" skips only values that are exactly zero'. Negatives are not skipped.
recorded.prompt:q-lp-start:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-start:a: Section 'An LP Starts From a Basis, Not a Hint': 'simplex solvers prefer a basis to a hint.'
recorded.prompt:q-lp-start:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-start:b: 'A basis can be stored... used by any later process; a kept-alive solver cannot.' A new solver in a new process has no prior state.
recorded.prompt:q-lp-start:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-start:d: 'from scratch, GLOP needed 338 simplex iterations; from the basis... 32'.
